    <content type="html"><h2>What's Changed</h2>
<p>This release resolves <a title="GHSA-fx35-mq7g-6g98" href="https://github.com/sigstore/cosign/security/advisories/GHSA-fx35-mq7g-6g98">GHSA-fx35-mq7g-6g98</a>, a verification bypass using an unexpected public key in a legacy bundle.</p>
<ul>
<li>Auto-detect default digest algorithm for public keys in <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="4914547594" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/sigstore/cosign/issues/5019" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/sigstore/cosign/pull/5019/hovercard" href="https://github.com/sigstore/cosign/pull/5019">#5019</a></li>
<li>fix(pkcs11key): return an error instead of panicking when no key pair matches in <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="4932867402" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/sigstore/cosign/issues/5022" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/sigstore/cosign/pull/5022/hovercard" href="https://github.com/sigstore/cosign/pull/5022">#5022</a></li>
<li>Supporting OCI Signing with X.509 Certificate Chain in <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="3779834803" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/sigstore/cosign/issues/4614" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/sigstore/cosign/pull/4614/hovercard" href="https://github.com/sigstore/cosign/pull/4614">#4614</a></li>
<li>test(inspect): replace mock TSA client usage with local timestamp response generator in <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="4932189369" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/sigstore/cosign/issues/5021" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/sigstore/cosign/pull/5021/hovercard" href="https://github.com/sigstore/cosign/pull/5021">#5021</a></li>
<li>fix: prevent shell completions for various options not taking filenames in <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5029986419" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/sigstore/cosign/issues/5032" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/sigstore/cosign/pull/5032/hovercard" href="https://github.com/sigstore/cosign/pull/5032">#5032</a></li>
<li>fix(blob): compare file checksums case-insensitively in <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5041799091" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/sigstore/cosign/issues/5036" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/sigstore/cosign/pull/5036/hovercard" href="https://github.com/sigstore/cosign/pull/5036">#5036</a></li>
<li>Verification bypass via public key in legacy bundle (<a title="GHSA-fx35-mq7g-6g98" href="https://github.com/sigstore/cosign/security/advisories/GHSA-fx35-mq7g-6g98">GHSA-fx35-mq7g-6g98</a>) in <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5075939187" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/sigstore/cosign/issues/5040" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/sigstore/cosign/pull/5040/hovercard" href="https://github.com/sigstore/cosign/pull/5040">#5040</a></li>

    <content type="html"><h2>Changelog</h2>
<p>This release backports <a title="GHSA-fx35-mq7g-6g98" href="https://github.com/sigstore/cosign/security/advisories/GHSA-fx35-mq7g-6g98">GHSA-fx35-mq7g-6g98</a> (Verification bypass via public key in legacy bundle) to Cosign v2.6.x.</p>
<p>We strongly encourage folks to continue their migration to the bundle format. The Cosign v3.1.x releases support both formats; the primary change being that the default for signing is the bundle format (although you can specify --new-bundle-format=false to sign with the old format). The verification commands in Cosign v3.1.x support both formats, and will try to detect the format for you for maximum compatibility.</p>
<h3>Thanks to all contributors!</h3></content>

    <content type="html"><p>This may be the last Cosign v3.1 release, as we finish deprecations and removing unused functionality. Soon we'll start work on Cosign v4 where we will remove things that are currently deprecated. We'll continue to support Cosign v3, with it's opt-in backwards compatibility, as described in <a href="https://github.com/sigstore/cosign/blob/main/VERSIONING.md">our versioning policy</a>.</p>
<p>If you haven't already, now is an excellent time to move to the bundle format that has been supported since Cosign v2.6.</p>
<p>We have received a ton of fixes over the past month from folks using Cosign in a variety of environments - thank you all!</p>

    <title>v2.6.4</title>
    <content type="html"><p>This release is a backport of OCI manifest fixes, and better support for <code>cosign attestation download</code> when you are using a mix of old Cosign signatures with the more recent bundle format.</p>
<p>We strongly encourage folks to continue their migration to the bundle format. The Cosign v3.1.x releases support both formats; the primary change being that the default for signing is the bundle format (although you can specify <code>--new-bundle-format=false</code> to sign with the old format). The verification commands in Cosign v3.1.x support both formats, and will try to detect the format for you for maximum compatibility.</p>

    <content type="html"><h2>What's Changed</h2>
<p><em>Note: v3.1.0 was skipped due to a bug in our release pipeline. v3.1.1 is identical to v3.1.0</em></p>
<p>This release deprecates a number of flags related to verification material input for trust root material, as well as the bundle format, standardized across Sigstore SDKs, which is now the default output and input for signing and verifying respectively. You may continue to use the deprecated flags with Cosign v3.x releases. The deprecated flags will be removed in a future Cosign v4 release.</p>
<p>This release also updates the signing path for logging to Rekor v2. DSSE attestations will be logged as hashed entries, using the DSSE's pre-auth encoding (PAE). This should unblock developers who want to upload large signed DSSEs such as SBOMs.</p>

    <title>v3.0.5</title>
    <content type="html"><h1>v3.0.5</h1>
<p>v3.0.5 resolves a <a href="https://github.com/sigstore/cosign/security/advisories/GHSA-wfqv-66vq-46rm">low-severity advisory</a> for private PKIs.</p>
<h2>Deprecations</h2>
<ul>
<li>Deprecate rekor-entry-type flag (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="3918481020" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/sigstore/cosign/issues/4691" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/sigstore/cosign/pull/4691/hovercard" href="https://github.com/sigstore/cosign/pull/4691">#4691</a>)</li>
<li>Deprecate cosign triangulate (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="3879267026" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/sigstore/cosign/issues/4676" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/sigstore/cosign/pull/4676/hovercard" href="https://github.com/sigstore/cosign/pull/4676">#4676</a>)</li>
<li>Deprecate cosign copy (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="3891788954" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/sigstore/cosign/issues/4681" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/sigstore/cosign/pull/4681/hovercard" href="https://github.com/sigstore/cosign/pull/4681">#4681</a>)</li>
</ul>
<h2>Features</h2>
<ul>
<li>Automatically require signed timestamp with Rekor v2 entries (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="3849730713" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/sigstore/cosign/issues/4666" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/sigstore/cosign/pull/4666/hovercard" href="https://github.com/sigstore/cosign/pull/4666">#4666</a>)</li>
<li>Allow --local-image with --new-bundle-format for v2 and v3 signatures (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="3804206133" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/sigstore/cosign/issues/4626" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/sigstore/cosign/pull/4626/hovercard" href="https://github.com/sigstore/cosign/pull/4626">#4626</a>)</li>
<li>Add mTLS support for TSA client connections when signing with a signing config (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="3794384227" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/sigstore/cosign/issues/4620" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/sigstore/cosign/pull/4620/hovercard" href="https://github.com/sigstore/cosign/pull/4620">#4620</a>)</li>
<li>Enforce TSA requirement for Rekor v2, Fuclio signing (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="3892561553" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/sigstore/cosign/issues/4683" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/sigstore/cosign/pull/4683/hovercard" href="https://github.com/sigstore/cosign/pull/4683">#4683</a>)</li>
</ul>
<h2>Bug Fixes</h2>
<ul>
<li>Add empty predicate to cosign sign when payload type is application/vnd.in-toto+json (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="3808738222" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/sigstore/cosign/issues/4635" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/sigstore/cosign/pull/4635/hovercard" href="https://github.com/sigstore/cosign/pull/4635">#4635</a>)</li>
<li>fix: avoid panic on malformed attestation payload (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="3835722218" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/sigstore/cosign/issues/4651" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/sigstore/cosign/pull/4651/hovercard" href="https://github.com/sigstore/cosign/pull/4651">#4651</a>)</li>
<li>fix: avoid panic on malformed tlog entries (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="3835531619" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/sigstore/cosign/issues/4649" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/sigstore/cosign/pull/4649/hovercard" href="https://github.com/sigstore/cosign/pull/4649">#4649</a>)</li>
<li>fix: avoid panic on malformed replace payload (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="3835813663" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/sigstore/cosign/issues/4653" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/sigstore/cosign/pull/4653/hovercard" href="https://github.com/sigstore/cosign/pull/4653">#4653</a>)</li>
<li>Gracefully fail if bundle payload body is not a string (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="3835129934" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/sigstore/cosign/issues/4648" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/sigstore/cosign/pull/4648/hovercard" href="https://github.com/sigstore/cosign/pull/4648">#4648</a>)</li>
<li>Verify validity of chain rather than just certificate (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="3848857577" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/sigstore/cosign/issues/4663" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/sigstore/cosign/pull/4663/hovercard" href="https://github.com/sigstore/cosign/pull/4663">#4663</a>)</li>
<li>fix: avoid panic on malformed tlog entry body (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="3835774043" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/sigstore/cosign/issues/4652" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/sigstore/cosign/pull/4652/hovercard" href="https://github.com/sigstore/cosign/pull/4652">#4652</a>)</li>
</ul>
<h2>Documentation</h2>
<ul>
<li>docs(cosign): clarify RFC3161 revocation semantics (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="3819852521" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/sigstore/cosign/issues/4642" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/sigstore/cosign/pull/4642/hovercard" href="https://github.com/sigstore/cosign/pull/4642">#4642</a>)</li>
<li>Fix typo in CLI help (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="3946356212" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/sigstore/cosign/issues/4701" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/sigstore/cosign/pull/4701/hovercard" href="https://github.com/sigstore/cosign/pull/4701">#4701</a>)</li>
</ul>
